sections.heading: How is a home tutor who travels from another Mumbai suburb checked?
paragraphs: The same way as any other tutor, plus two checks that only matter over distance: whether they have actually held a long commute for a full term before, and what their wet-weather and traffic fallback is. Identity documents, the claimed qualification, and a subject conversation with somebody who knows the current syllabus version come first for everyone. Then, for a travelling match, references are asked a narrower question: did this person turn up, on time, in July.

The syllabus-version check is worth understanding because it is where distance and competence get confused. A teacher who taught Mathematics under the pre-2019 Diploma Programme structure and has not taught Analysis and Approaches is not a weak teacher, but they are the wrong teacher, and a thin-supply area is exactly where that mismatch slips through because the family is relieved to have found anyone. Ask which specification and which first-assessment year a tutor has taught most recently. An IB private tutor Mumbai parents interview themselves will answer that in one sentence if the answer is good.

What you should check yourself, beyond anything a platform can verify: reliability under your specific conditions. Ask the tutor to describe their route and their departure time, not their travel time, because a stated travel time is an estimate and a departure time is a commitment. Ask what happens on a day the Ghodbunder Road or Eastern Express Highway stretch is blocked. Ask whether they will teach from your building's clubhouse or study room if a lift is out. And ask about gate access in plain terms: many Navi Mumbai and Thane societies require a resident to approve each visitor, and a standing weekly entry on the gate register is the difference between a smooth term and a tutor waiting twenty minutes at every session.

Then put the arrangement in writing, which matters far more at distance than nearby. A long-distance arrangement that survives a term names: the fixed day and start time; the session length; a travel buffer the family accepts, meaning the tutor may arrive within a stated window rather than to the minute; a cancellation notice period that runs both ways; how many make-up sessions are owed and by when; who is informed if a session is cut short; the exam-season blackout weeks when the schedule changes; and a review date at the end of the term when either side can end it without argument. None of that is bureaucracy. It is the difference between a complaint in week six and a renegotiation in week six.
bullets: Identity, claimed qualification and a subject conversation on the current syllabus
References asked specifically about turning up on time in July
Which specification and first-assessment year the tutor taught most recently
Departure time, not travel time: one is a commitment, the other an estimate
Standing gate-register entry agreed before the first session, not at the gate
Written arrangement: slot, buffer, notice period, make-ups, review date

sections.heading: The four honest options when nobody near you teaches the subject
paragraphs: There are four, and only four, and the skill is choosing deliberately rather than taking whichever appears first. Option one is an online specialist for the scarce subject. Option two is a local generalist for the routine work. Option three is a weekend intensive with somebody who will travel for a longer block. Option four is waiting for the right match instead of accepting a poor one. Most families in Vasai, Virar, Kalyan, Dombivli, Panvel, Dronagiri, Kasarvadavali or Lonavala end up using two of them together, which is correct.

The online specialist wins when the subject is hard, the student is in DP or at IGCSE Extended tier, and the work is problem-solving or drafting: Physics HL theory and IA write-up, Chemistry HL data processing, Maths Analysis and Approaches HL, Economics HL commentaries, English Paper 1 analysis. It loses when the student is young, when attention needs managing, or when apparatus and orals are central. It also loses quietly when a family uses it for all six subjects because it is easy to book, and the child ends up with no adult physically checking the work. IB home tuition in Mumbai and an online specialist are not competitors here; they do different jobs.

The local generalist is undervalued by anxious parents and is often the highest-return hire in a thin-supply area. A good local teacher who does not know the Diploma Programme syllabus can still fix the things that actually cost marks: unmarked homework, no revision schedule, illegible working, questions never asked in class, a student who has not opened the subject guide. They handle MYP and SL work directly and they handle the operational layer for everything else. The failure mode is letting them mark HL internal assessment drafts, where syllabus-specific criteria knowledge is the whole job, or letting them teach a specification they have not read. Be explicit about the boundary when you hire them. A platform that lists all IB and IGCSE subjects and every tutor in Mumbai on it still has to tell you which of those tutors is the generalist and which is the specialist, and a family in a thin area should ask for that label outright.

The weekend intensive and the wait are the two options families consider least and should consider most. A weekend block works because the economics work: a tutor accepts a Dombivli or Ulwe journey for a substantial Saturday session when the same journey for a one-hour Wednesday slot is unreasonable. Run it as all IB and IGCSE subjects as home classes Mumbai families can schedule around one longer visit, not as scattered hours. The wait, meanwhile, is a real strategy and not just failure. If it is August, if the student is in MYP or DP1, and if the only available tutor is a poor fit, waiting three or four weeks for a better one costs very little and avoids the worst outcome in tutoring, which is a bad arrangement that nobody ends because ending it feels like going backwards. If it is November of DP2, the wait is no longer affordable and you take the best available option and manage it tightly. That is the whole decision rule, and it depends on the calendar, not on optimism.
bullets: Online specialist: hard subjects, older students, problem-solving and drafting
Local generalist: homework discipline, revision structure, MYP and SL teaching
Weekend intensive: one longer block makes a long journey economically sensible
Waiting: cheap in August, affordable in DP1, unaffordable by November of DP2
Most thin-area families should combine two of the four, not pick one
Never let a generalist mark HL internal assessment drafts

sections.heading: Is a nearby adequate tutor better than a distant excellent one?
paragraphs: Usually yes, and the reason is attendance. A competent tutor fifteen minutes away delivers thirty-odd sessions a term. An excellent tutor an hour away in evening traffic delivers fewer, arrives tired, and is the first thing cancelled when something else comes up. Over a term, consistency beats brilliance for most students, most subjects, most of the time. That is an uncomfortable thing for a tutoring platform to say and it is true.

The exceptions are narrow enough to list. Distance is worth paying for when the work is assessment-specific and the local option simply cannot do it: an HL science internal assessment where criteria knowledge decides the mark, Mathematics Analysis and Approaches HL where a generalist will teach the wrong method, an Extended Essay in a subject nobody locally supervises, a Theory of Knowledge essay that needs somebody who has read real exemplars, a retake where the student already knows the content and needs technique, or a language B oral where only a trained examiner's ear helps. In those cases, do not compromise on competence. Instead, change the format: move it online, or move it to a weekend block, so distance stops being a weekly tax.

Progress should be visible on a schedule. At four weeks, you are not looking at marks. You are looking at whether sessions happened as planned, whether the student can say what they worked on without being prompted, whether homework comes back, and whether the tutor has told you something about your child you did not know. If a long-distance arrangement has already lost two sessions by week four, that is your answer and it is not about teaching quality. At one term, expect specifics: a clear picture of which topics are secure, an internal assessment with a defined research question rather than a vague plan, and a revision structure that exists on paper. At one exam cycle, expect grades to have moved in the subjects that were worked on, and expect a frank account of the ones that did not move.

We do not guarantee grades, and anybody who does in this market is selling something else. What a well-designed arrangement controls is the work: hours actually taught, drafts actually written and marked, past papers actually attempted under time. Examination outcomes depend on the student, the cohort, the moderation of their internal assessments and a session they sit on a day we have no part in. Where families in thin-supply areas are most often misled is not about grades at all; it is about availability, somebody promising a weekday evening slot in Virar or Dronagiri that was never going to hold past October.
bullets: Four weeks: sessions kept, homework returned, one new insight about your child
One term: secure topics named, IA research question defined, revision on paper
One exam cycle: movement in the subjects worked on, honesty about the rest
Two sessions lost by week four in a travelling arrangement is a decision point
Pay for distance on HL IAs, EE supervision, retake technique and language orals
Consistency beats brilliance for most students across a full term

sections.heading: Getting started with home tuition from a thin-supply Mumbai address
paragraphs: Come with four things and the first conversation gets somewhere: the board and year, the exact subject list with HL/SL or Core/Extended marked, the last report card or mock marks, and your postal address with the society name. The address is not a formality. It is what lets us tell you honestly, in the first call, which of your subjects can be matched locally and which cannot, instead of discovering it after two weeks of scheduling.

Bring two more things if you have them. First, the school's assessment calendar for the term, because it determines whether waiting for a better match is cheap or expensive right now. Second, an honest account of what has already been tried, including arrangements that quietly stopped. Families in Kasarvadavali, Dombivli and Ulwe very often arrive having already lost a term to a tutor who kept cancelling, and knowing that changes what we recommend: usually a weekend block plus online rather than another attempt at a weekday local slot that the road will defeat again.

The first session is diagnostic and should feel like one. A tutor should open the student's actual notebook and the actual mark scheme for the last test, not deliver a lecture. By the end of it you should have two or three named weak topics rather than a general impression, a view on whether the problem is content or technique, and a proposed structure for the next six weeks. If the arrangement involves travel, the first session is also where the practical details get settled in front of everyone: the gate-register entry, where in the flat the lessons happen, the departure time, the traffic fallback.

Then review at the end of the term with the date already in the diary. Thin-supply arrangements need reviewing more often than convenient ones, because the thing most likely to fail is logistics, not teaching, and logistics degrade slowly. If it is working, extend it. If the travel is clearly not holding, move that subject online or into a weekend block before it costs another month. That is the single habit that separates families who make a difficult address work from families who cycle through tutors for two years.
bullets: Bring board, year, subject list with HL/SL marked, last marks, postal address
Bring the term assessment calendar: it prices the option of waiting
Say what was already tried, including arrangements that quietly stopped
First session opens the notebook and the mark scheme, not a lecture
Travel details settled in session one: gate entry, departure time, fallback
Term-end review already in the diary before the first session happens

faqs.question: I searched and got nobody in Virar. Is IB Gram actually available there?
faqs.answer: Yes, but not always as a weekday home tutor, and we will say which it is before you commit. When a parent searches IB Gram tutors near me in Mumbai from Virar or Nalasopara, the honest position is that there are few local teachers who have taught the IB or IGCSE syllabuses, because there are few such schools north of Dahisar East. What is reliably available is an online specialist for the hard subjects, a local generalist for homework and revision discipline, and a weekend block with a tutor travelling up from Borivali or Kandivali East. A weekday evening slot from a Western Suburbs tutor is the one thing we are cautious about promising.

faqs.question: Will a tutor travel to Kasarvadavali on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Some will, but Ghodbunder Road decides whether it lasts a term. The same run that takes twenty minutes off-peak from Thane station takes close to an hour in the evening peak, so a 6.30pm start means a tutor leaving home before five and getting back after ten. That is sustainable for one or two tutors and not for most. What works better in Kasarvadavali, Waghbil and Owale is a later fixed slot with a stated arrival window, or a Saturday block. If you need a weekday arrangement, ask the tutor for their departure time rather than their travel time, and agree the buffer in writing.

faqs.question: Is it better to wait for the right tutor or start with whoever is available?
faqs.answer: It depends entirely on the month, not on patience. In late August through October, with a student in MYP or DP1, waiting three or four weeks for a good match costs very little and avoids the real risk, which is a mediocre arrangement nobody ends. From December onwards for a DP2 student, waiting is expensive: mocks are done, internal assessment deadlines are close, and a reasonable tutor starting now beats an excellent one starting in February. If you must start with an imperfect match, set a four-week review date at the outset so ending it is a scheduled decision rather than a confrontation.

faqs.question: Can one tutor cover all the IB and IGCSE subjects my child takes?
faqs.answer: Below Diploma Programme level, often yes; at HL, almost never, and you should be suspicious of anyone who claims it. One good MYP teacher can genuinely handle Maths, the integrated sciences and English for a Year 8 student. A DP2 student taking Physics HL, Chemistry HL and Mathematics Analysis and Approaches HL needs separate specialists, because each HL internal assessment is scored against subject-specific criteria that take real familiarity. The workable structure in a thin-supply area is one local tutor holding the routine subjects and the overall timetable, plus a specialist per scarce HL subject.

faqs.question: Does online really work for a Physics HL internal assessment?
faqs.answer: For most of it, yes; for the practical session, no. Choosing a research question that is actually measurable, designing a method with genuine uncertainty analysis, and redrafting twelve pages until the evaluation earns its marks are all conversation and document work, and they transfer to a screen with little loss. What does not transfer is somebody standing next to the apparatus noticing that the light gate triggers twice or the trolley sticks. The usual fix is one in-person or school-lab session around data collection, with everything before and after it online, which is exactly the hybrid shape that suits an outer address.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on when the tutor travels a long way?
faqs.answer: Board and level, subject scarcity, session length, mode and travel distance, in roughly that order, and we will not quote a figure here because it would be invented. A DP HL science specialist costs more than MYP homework support anywhere in the city. Travel adds to it, which is precisely why a single longer weekend block is often better value for an outer address than two short weekday visits covering the same ground. Online removes the travel component entirely. Ask any tutor to state the rate, the session length and whether travel is included as one number before you start.

faqs.question: Our society in Panvel needs a gate pass for every visitor. How is that handled?
faqs.answer: Set up a standing weekly entry on the gate register before the first session, not at the gate on the day. Most Navi Mumbai and Thane complexes allow a resident to pre-approve a recurring visitor for a fixed day and time, and in Panvel, Kharghar and Ulwe that single administrative step removes the most common source of lost minutes. Tell the tutor which gate to use and whether the app-based approval needs a parent to be reachable by phone. If a lift is out or the flat is crowded, ask whether the clubhouse or society study room can be used instead.

faqs.question: There has been no progress after a month with our long-distance arrangement. What now?
faqs.answer: First check attendance, because in travelling arrangements that is the usual cause. Count how many of the planned sessions actually happened at full length and on time. If two or more were lost or cut short, the problem is logistics and the answer is to change the format: move that subject online, or consolidate into one weekend block. If attendance was fine and there is still nothing to show, ask the tutor for two named weak topics and a six-week plan in writing. A tutor who cannot produce that after a month is not the right tutor, and we will arrange a replacement.

faqs.question: How does a replacement work if the tutor is the only one covering that subject nearby?
faqs.answer: By changing the mode rather than hunting for a second local person who does not exist. Tell us the arrangement is not working and what specifically is wrong, and we look first at the same subject taught online or as a weekend block, which widens the pool from your suburb to the whole city. The outgoing tutor is asked for a short handover: topics covered, current internal assessment status, what was set and not completed. We do not expect you to keep an arrangement that is failing because the local supply is thin, and we would rather move the format than defend a bad match.

faqs.question: We live in Lonavala and come into Mumbai at weekends. What actually works?
faqs.answer: A weekend-anchored plan, treated as the main structure rather than a supplement. Lonavala has effectively no weekday market for IB or IGCSE teaching, so the realistic shape is a substantial Saturday or Sunday session at your Mumbai address or at the tutor's location, plus two short online check-ins midweek to keep work moving. Families with a Khar West, Powai or Vashi base often run the weekend block there. Set the online check-ins at a fixed time on fixed days, because midweek sessions with no anchor are the first thing that quietly stops happening.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be at home during a home tuition session?
faqs.answer: Not for the teaching, but somebody should be in the flat for the first few sessions and reachable afterwards. For younger MYP and PYP students, having an adult present in the next room genuinely changes how a session runs. For DP students it matters less, and many prefer it. The practical requirements are smaller than people expect: a table rather than a bed, a plug socket, enough light, and a room where the television is not audible. If the flat is crowded at that hour, ask about the society study room before assuming home tuition will not work.

Then you speak to the shortlisted tutors yourself before anything is booked.

sections.heading: How IB Gram turns one Mumbai enquiry into a shortlist of three tutors
paragraphs: Start with the gap, not the format. A parent in Khar West who says her DP1 daughter is at a 4 in Chemistry Higher Level (HL), fine in Biology, and has not started her Chemistry Internal Assessment has described two completely different problems. The 4 in Chemistry is a content and exam-technique gap, and a group coaching class drills that perfectly well. The unstarted IA is individual by definition: nobody can run a group lesson on one student's own research question, chosen variables and criterion scores, because no two students in the batch are writing the same investigation.

Most parents open the call with a version of IB Gram vs coaching institutes in Mumbai, and the honest reply starts with questions back. Which board, which year, which subjects at HL and which at Standard Level (SL)? What did the last two report cards actually say? Does the student already attend a class in Ghatkopar, Vashi or Borivali, and which evenings are genuinely free after it? If a class is already covering breadth and timed drilling, a home tutor should not repeat it. The honest brief in that case is narrow: two subjects, the IA, and nothing else.

Matching then runs on geography and timetable before it runs on subject fit. A home tutor who lives in Chembur and a student who lives in Borivali will hold for three weeks and then start cancelling, however good the teaching is. Tutors are matched inside the zone, which is why a Powai request goes to tutors who already cross JVLR and a Nerul request goes to tutors working inside the Navi Mumbai nodes. Profiles arrive with the board, the level and the papers taught written on them, and the parent chooses rather than being assigned.
bullets: 1. Send the board, year, subjects, HL and SL split, and your free evenings.
2. A counsellor calls to separate the content gap from the coursework and IA gap.
3. Two or three matched profiles reach you with board, level and papers taught.
4. You run a first session at home or online and say what you thought.
5. Keep the tutor, swap the tutor, or narrow the brief to one subject.

sections.heading: Which programmes does a group coaching class cover well, and which need one-to-one?
paragraphs: A group class covers the examined end of a programme well and the internally assessed end poorly. For the IGCSE years, and for Diploma Programme (DP) Papers 1, 2 and 3, a class works properly: the syllabus is fixed, the past papers are public, and twenty students can sit the same mock on the same Saturday. For the Middle Years Programme (MYP), for the IA that every DP subject carries, for the Extended Essay (EE) and for Theory of Knowledge (TOK), the work is individual, and a batch cannot mark one student's own piece as one student's own piece.

MYP is the clearest case. There is no public past-paper bank to drill, the four criteria are applied to tasks each school sets itself, and a Year 9 student in Juhu is assessed on a task her counterpart in Powai never sees. Coaching classes rarely build a strong MYP product, because there is nothing standard to teach to. That is not a failing of anyone running a class; it is the format meeting a programme it was never designed for. MYP support is mostly reading the student's own task sheet and the criterion descriptors with her.

IGCSE sits at the opposite end. Cambridge International Education and Pearson Edexcel publish years of past papers, the Core and Extended tiers are clearly defined, and a Class 10 student sitting the May series benefits enormously from volume: forty papers under timed conditions beats eight. A class supplies that volume cheaply, and a weekly batch with a teacher who has marked those papers is genuinely good value. Where the format struggles is the Core versus Extended decision itself, which turns on one student's Maths ceiling, her other six subjects and what she wants to do at DP.
bullets: IGCSE Core or Extended: a class drills it, a tutor helps decide it
MYP criteria A to D are applied to school-set tasks, not public papers
DP Paper 1, 2 and 3 technique: group drilling is genuinely efficient here
Every DP subject carries an IA that must be the student's own work
The TOK essay and the Extended Essay need a reader, not a lecture

sections.heading: Subject by subject: where a Mumbai coaching class drills well and where it cannot
paragraphs: Maths is the subject where a coaching class earns its fee honestly. Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretation at SL is a long syllabus with a predictable question bank, and a batch working through it chapter by chapter with weekly timed sets does something a single weekly home tutor cannot do as cheaply. The Maths exploration is the other half of that grade, and it is one student's own topic, model and reflection. A class can explain what the criteria reward. It cannot sit with your daughter and tell her the topic she picked is too thin to carry a personal engagement mark.

In the sciences the split is sharper still. Physics Paper 1 multiple choice and Paper 2 structured response reward exactly the kind of repetition a batch provides. The Physics IA is an individual investigation with its own uncertainty analysis and its own evaluation, and two students sitting side by side cannot submit the same variables. Chemistry, Biology and Environmental Systems and Societies all behave the same way. Economics and Business Management carry commentaries and research projects judged on one student's chosen article or company. Group teaching gets you the theory reliably; the written piece needs somebody reading that student's draft.

Languages and humanities sit furthest from the group format. English A Language and Literature has an Individual Oral built on a global issue and texts the student selects; History carries an IA with its own sources and its own evaluation section. Hindi B, French B and Spanish B orals are one-to-one assessments by design. A home tutor who has marked those orals can run a recorded mock in your drawing room on a Tuesday evening and play it back. A batch of eighteen cannot give eighteen students a mock oral each, every week, and nobody should pretend otherwise.
bullets: Maths SL syllabus volume: a class covers it cheaply and covers it well
Maths exploration: one student, one topic, one reader of the draft
Physics and Chemistry IA uncertainty analysis cannot be taught to twenty at once
History IA sources and evaluation need line-by-line feedback on that draft
Language B orals are one-to-one assessments and need one-to-one mocks

sections.heading: Where coaching classes cluster in Mumbai, and what travel does to the comparison
paragraphs: Coaching classes cluster where the rent works and the trains stop: Ghatkopar on the Central Line and Metro Line 1, Vashi on the Harbour Line, Thane around the station and Pokhran Road, and Borivali on the Western Line. That clustering is rational, and for a family living a ten-minute walk from one it is the cheapest good option available. Travel is the part of IB Gram vs coaching institutes in Mumbai that families underrate, and it is the part that flips the answer. Families across Mumbai, Maharashtra run the same arithmetic every June.

Work it through. A DP1 student in Cuffe Parade or Colaba attending a class in Ghatkopar spends close to three hours a week in a car on the Eastern Freeway before any teaching happens. South Mumbai families therefore bring the tutor to the flat instead: Worli, Walkeshwar, Tardeo and Peddar Road are short distances on slow roads, and while Metro Line 3 has helped the Cuffe Parade to BKC run and the Coastal Road has helped the western edge, neither touches the evening school-run crawl at Haji Ali.

In the Western Suburbs the Western Express Highway and the Western Line run north to south, so a Khar West or Santacruz family reaches a class in Andheri West easily, and a Malad or Kandivali family reaches one in Borivali. Crossing the highway at 6pm is the expensive part, which is why matching along the line beats matching across it. Metro Lines 2A and 7 have made the Dahisar to Andheri leg bearable. In the Central Suburbs, Powai and Chandivali have no station of their own, so everything moves by road through JVLR or the SCLR.

The Eastern Suburbs run from Chembur and Govandi up through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund, with the Eastern Express Highway and the Eastern Freeway doing the work the map hides. Navi Mumbai is nodal: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel sit along Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, and the Atal Setu has shortened the island crossing without making a weeknight lesson across it sensible. In Thane, Ghodbunder Road decides everything, and a family in Kasarvadavali reaching Majiwada in the evening peak loses nearly an hour each way.
bullets: Classes cluster at Ghatkopar, Vashi, Thane and Borivali for sound transport reasons
South Mumbai: Colaba, Cuffe Parade and Worli are short distances on slow roads
Powai and Chandivali have no station; JVLR and the SCLR set the timing
Navi Mumbai works node to node: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel
Ghodbunder Road between Thane station and Kasarvadavali doubles evening travel time

sections.heading: How the Mumbai school calendar decides whether you need a class, a tutor, or both
paragraphs: The calendar is what makes the both answer so common here. Most IB and IGCSE schools in Mumbai run an August to May year, which stacks DP1 mocks and MYP personal project deadlines into the same window as DP2 IA submissions. Between November and February a DP2 student can face four or five IA deadlines, a TOK essay, an EE final draft and school mocks inside fourteen weeks. A batch cannot reschedule itself around one student's IA week, and it should not be expected to; that is simply what a shared timetable means.

Schools set internal deadlines well ahead of the official ones, and they differ from each other. Families at Dhirubhai Ambani International School and the American School of Bombay in BKC, at Ecole Mondiale World School and Jamnabai Narsee International School in Juhu, at Oberoi International School off JVLR, at Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, at Cathedral and John Connon School and B.D. Somani International School in South Mumbai, at NES International School in Mulund West and at D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul all work to different internal dates. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of those schools, with any coaching institute or with any board; they are named here as local context only.

That is the practical reason to split the year rather than choose once. From June to October, breadth and drilling matter most, and a class is good value for exactly that. From November to February the work turns individual: a Physics IA draft, a History IA, a TOK essay and an EE interim, each needing a reader who knows the criteria and the mark bands. From March the pressure is paper volume again, and a batch full of mocks is hard to beat. Plenty of families reduce tutor hours in term one and increase them in term two.
bullets: August to May year: mocks and IA deadlines land in the same window
November to February is coursework season, not syllabus-drilling season
School internal deadlines run ahead of board deadlines and differ by school
March to May rewards paper volume, which a shared batch supplies cheaply
Ask your class whether it will mark an IA draft; many honestly will not

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or a class: how do Mumbai families actually combine them?
paragraphs: Most combine them like this: the class for breadth and paper volume, home tuition for the two subjects that are actually failing and for the IA. Home tuition leads because the tutor absorbs the travel instead of the student, and a tired DP2 student at 8pm learns more at her own desk than she does in a car on the Western Express Highway. The class keeps the discipline of a fixed slot, which for a student who will not sit down alone is worth more than any one-to-one hour.

Home tuition in Mumbai buys three things a batch structurally cannot. The tutor works on the student's own script rather than a worked example on a board. The session can move: an IGCSE home tutor in Mumbai can drop the planned Trigonometry hour because the Chemistry test moved to Thursday. And the student's own textbook, notes and calculator are already on the table. The cost is real, though: one hour of IB home tuition in Mumbai costs more than one hour of a shared class, and a single weekly hour cannot cover six subjects.

Online is the honest answer to subject scarcity and to traffic. For Further Mathematics HL, Latin, Japanese B or a specific EE supervisor, an IB online tutor in Mumbai may be the only realistic match, and sharing an annotated PDF of a marked essay works better than most parents expect. It is weaker for a student who needs somebody physically beside her to stop her drifting, and weaker again for Years 7 to 9, where attention is the whole battle. Say which of those two describes your child and the choice makes itself.

Hybrid is where most families land after a term: a home tutor for the heavy subject and the IA on a weekday evening, an online session for the scarce subject on Sunday morning, and the coaching class continuing for timed practice. That is three commitments, so protect one free evening deliberately. Asking for all IB and IGCSE subjects in home classes across Mumbai is rarely the right request; two subjects covered properly beats six covered thinly, and it costs less.
bullets: Home tuition: the tutor travels, the student stays at her own desk
A class gives cost per hour and a timetable that creates real discipline
Online solves subject scarcity and the 6pm Western Express Highway problem
Hybrid: class for drilling, home tutor for the IA and two weak subjects
Protect one free evening a week or the whole plan collapses by October

sections.heading: How is a home tutor checked, and what should you check at a coaching institute?
paragraphs: Every tutor is checked on identity, qualification and board experience before a profile is sent to you, and the profile states which board, which level and which papers that tutor has actually taught. Verification is where IB Gram vs coaching institutes in Mumbai gets practical, because you can ask a class the same three questions you would ask a home tutor: who specifically teaches this batch, have they taught this syllabus before, and will they still be teaching it in January?

The checks that matter are narrow ones. A Physics degree does not mean somebody has marked a DP Physics IA against its criteria. Years of experience with a Class 12 state syllabus does not transfer to Paper 3 of DP Chemistry. So the useful question is syllabus-specific: which board, which subject guide, which components. We ask for proof of qualification and for teaching history, and the profile says plainly where a tutor is strong and where they are not, because an oversold match wastes your term as much as our reputation.

What you should check yourself is identical in both formats. Sit in on the first session, or stay in the next room with the door open. Then read the first marked piece of work: does the feedback name the criterion and the mark band, or does it say good effort, keep going? Ask what happens if the tutor or the batch teacher leaves mid-year. A class should be able to tell you the batch size and who is in the room; a platform should be able to replace a tutor without an argument about it.

Two limits worth stating. IB Gram matches and verifies rather than employing tutors as school staff, so your feedback after the first two sessions is what confirms the fit. And we do not guarantee grades: no IB private tutor in Mumbai, and no coaching class anywhere, can promise a 7. What verification buys is a shorter route to a competent match and fewer wasted weeks, which is a smaller claim and a true one.
bullets: Identity, qualification and board experience checked before any profile is sent
Profiles state the board, the level and the papers actually taught
Ask a class who teaches the batch and whether they stay until January
Read the first marked draft: criterion and mark band, or vague praise?
Replacement without an argument is the real test of platform or institute

sections.heading: IB Gram vs coaching institutes in Mumbai: the honest format comparison
paragraphs: Here is IB Gram vs coaching institutes in Mumbai without the sales layer. A good coaching class genuinely wins on five things. Cost per hour, because the teacher's time is shared. Peer pace, because a student who watches four classmates finish a paper in forty minutes works faster than she would at home. Structured drilling, because somebody has already sequenced the past papers into an order that makes sense. A fixed timetable, which creates discipline a willing-but-drifting student cannot create alone. And sheer volume of exam practice, which is simply cheaper to supply to a batch than to one person.

One-to-one wins on a different five. Diagnosis: discovering that a DP1 student's Maths problem is an algebra gap from three years ago rather than the current chapter takes one session with one student, and is invisible in a batch of twenty. Internal assessment and coursework: the IA, the EE, the TOK essay and the MYP personal project are individual pieces, and no group format can mark one student's own research question. Criterion-referenced feedback on her own draft. HL depth, where the Options and the extra HL content thin out fast in a mixed batch. And scheduling, which in this city is not a minor point.

Which is why the useful answer for most families is both, with a clear division of labour. Use the class for breadth, drilling and the discipline of the timetable. Use a home tutor for the two subjects that are genuinely failing and for the IA calendar from November to February. Asking for all IB and IGCSE subjects from one home tutor in Mumbai is the commonest mistake we see, and a parent in Vashi or Ghatkopar whose son already walks to a class should not pay twice for the same syllabus coverage. One subject, one IA, two hours a week is the cheaper and better brief.

There are also cases where a class alone is right and you do not need a platform at all. If your daughter is steady across her subjects, submits IA drafts before the school deadline, revises without being chased, and attends a nearby class she likes, a tutor adds cost rather than marks. The same holds for an IGCSE student who is doing fine and mainly needs paper volume before the May series, and for a family where the class is a short walk away and the budget is tight. An honest read of IB Gram vs tuition institutes in Mumbai has to include the case for changing nothing.
bullets: Class wins: cost per hour, peer pace, drilling, timetable, exam volume
One-to-one wins: diagnosis, coursework, criterion feedback, HL depth, scheduling
Both: class for breadth, tutor for the two failing subjects and the IA
A steady, independent student living near a good class needs neither of us
Hiring a tutor for all six subjects duplicates what the class already drills

sections.heading: What should progress look like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle?
paragraphs: At four weeks you should see a diagnosis and one changed habit, not a grade. The tutor should be able to tell you in a single sentence what is wrong: she cannot read a Paper 2 data question, or nobody has shown her how to structure the evaluation section of a History IA. You should also have one marked piece of work with criterion-level feedback on it. If after four weeks nobody can name the gap in plain words, the match is wrong and you should change it rather than wait politely.

At one term, roughly ten to twelve sessions, expect movement on that specific thing. An IA draft that has a research question and a method instead of just a topic. A Paper 1 score that moves because she now reads the stem before the options. Expect the school report to lag the work by several weeks, because a report averages a term that includes the weeks before anything changed. A student at a 4 in Chemistry HL in September is not at a 7 by December, and anybody in Mumbai telling you otherwise is selling rather than teaching.

At one exam cycle the honest picture includes what nobody controls. The May session is marked worldwide, grade boundaries move between sessions, and a well-prepared student can still land a point below her mocks. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and neither a coaching class nor a home tutor can. What you can reasonably hold anyone to is a competent match, honest feedback and a tutor who turns up on time. If a tutor is not working out, say so after the second session and a replacement is arranged; waiting until February costs you the term that mattered.
bullets: Four weeks: a named gap and one marked piece with criterion feedback
One term: a real IA draft, or a paper score that actually moves
School reports lag the work by several weeks, so read them accordingly
Grade boundaries move every session and nobody controls that
Raise a poor fit after the second session, not in February

sections.heading: Starting home tuition in Mumbai alongside a coaching class
paragraphs: If you already have a class, keep it for now and start narrow. Send the board, the year, the subject list with the HL and SL split, the class timetable you are working around, and the two evenings that are genuinely free. The useful first brief is almost never every subject at once; it is the one subject that is failing and the IA that has not been started. Narrow briefs get filled faster too, because one strong subject match is easier to find than six adequate ones.

For the first session have three things ready: the last school report, the most recent marked test or IA draft, and the subject guide or syllabus outline if the school has shared it. A good tutor spends much of that first hour reading the work rather than teaching, which feels slow and is exactly the point. By the end you should have a written plan covering what gets done weekly, what gets done before the next school assessment, and what is deliberately being left to the coaching class.

Then the practicalities, which decide whether the arrangement survives October. Tell us the society and the tower so the tutor can plan the gate pass, and say whether an adult will be at home during the session. Weekday slots between 5pm and 8pm go first, so a Saturday morning slot is often easier to hold across a full term. If you do want a home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai, say so, and we will tell you honestly whether two tutors, or one tutor plus your existing class, is the better structure.
bullets: Send board, year, HL and SL split, and your two free evenings
Have the last report and one marked draft ready for session one
Name the society and tower so the tutor clears the gate pass
Expect a written weekly plan, including what the class keeps covering
Saturday mornings hold better than 7pm weekday slots across a term

faqs.question: Is a coaching class or a one-to-one tutor better for IB?
faqs.answer: Neither is better in general; they are good at different parts of the Diploma Programme. Framed as IB Gram vs coaching institutes in Mumbai, the question has no single winner. A class is efficient for syllabus coverage, timed paper practice and the discipline of a fixed weekly slot. One-to-one is the only format that can diagnose a specific gap and support an Internal Assessment, an Extended Essay or a TOK essay, which are individual pieces of work by definition. Most families who get this right use a class for breadth and a tutor for the two subjects that are genuinely weak.

faqs.question: Can we do both a coaching class and home tuition without overloading the student?
faqs.answer: Yes, but only if you cut the brief down rather than stacking hours on top. A DP1 student already attending a class four evenings a week has no room for six more tutor hours; she has room for two, spent on the subject that is failing and on the IA her class will not mark. Drop one class subject if the batch allows it, keep one evening completely free, and put the home tuition slot on the day with no class. Overload shows up in November, not September, so plan the term two load back in August.

faqs.question: Why can a coaching class not help much with the IB Internal Assessment?
faqs.answer: Because an IA is assessed as one student's own work, so a batch cannot be taught through it the way a syllabus chapter can. A class can explain the criteria, show an exemplar and warn about common mistakes, and the better ones do all three. What it cannot do is sit with your daughter's chosen research question, her raw data and her uncertainty analysis and tell her the method will not produce enough of a trend to write about. The same applies to the Extended Essay, the TOK essay and the MYP personal project. Reading one specific draft is what one-to-one exists for.

faqs.question: What does a coaching class cost compared with one-to-one, and what drives the difference?
faqs.answer: A shared class is cheaper per hour because the teacher's time is split across the batch, and one-to-one costs more because it is not. We publish no price list, and IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on the board, the level, how scarce the subject is, the session length and how far the tutor travels to your flat. HL Physics or Further Mathematics costs more than MYP Maths because far fewer people can teach it properly. A long weekday run out to Kharghar or Kasarvadavali is priced in. Compare total monthly spend across both formats rather than headline hourly rates.

faqs.question: Our class is in Ghatkopar and we live in Powai. Is the travel worth it?
faqs.answer: It depends entirely on what the class is doing for your child, and Powai to Ghatkopar is the case where it often is not. Powai has no station of its own, so the trip runs by road through JVLR or down past Chandivali, which in the evening peak means forty minutes each way for a two-hour class. If the class is mainly paper drilling, that is four hours a week of car time for work a tutor can set as timed homework instead. Parents searching IB tutors near me in Mumbai are usually running this arithmetic already.

faqs.question: Can a home tutor come to our building in Thane in the evening?
faqs.answer: Yes, and the practical detail is the gate pass rather than the teaching. Tell us the complex, the tower and the wing, and whether your society needs a visitor entry at the main gate or an app approval from the flat, because a tutor held at the gate for fifteen minutes loses a quarter of the session. In Thane the Ghodbunder Road stretch decides which slots are realistic: a tutor coming from near Thane station reaches Kasarvadavali far faster at 4pm than at 7pm. Weekend mornings hold better across a full term than weekday evenings do.

faqs.question: Does online tuition work as well as a class for IGCSE paper practice?
faqs.answer: For timed paper practice specifically, a class is usually better, and online is better than nothing. Drilling benefits from a room where everyone starts together and nobody checks a phone, which is exactly what a batch provides. Online is strong for marking: a shared screen with an annotated Paper 4 script, criterion by criterion, is close to sitting beside the student and costs no travel. So the sensible split is drilling in the class or at home under a timer, and marked feedback online when the right subject specialist is in Kandivali and you are in Nerul.

faqs.question: What if there is no progress after a month?
faqs.answer: After four weeks you should at least have a clearly named gap, and if nobody can name it the match is wrong. Tell us, and we will either narrow the brief or change the tutor. A month is long enough to see a diagnosis, one marked piece of work with criterion-level feedback and one changed study habit. It is not long enough to move a school grade, particularly if the underlying gap goes back two years. Be specific when you complain: what was covered, what the student says is still unclear, and what the last marked draft looked like.

faqs.question: How do you handle a tutor who is not working out?
faqs.answer: Say so after the second session and a replacement is arranged without asking you to justify it. Fit failures are usually not about subject knowledge: the tutor talks too much, arrives late from Andheri East, or teaches at a pace built for a stronger student. We ask for one or two concrete examples so the next match is actually different rather than merely new, then send a fresh profile with the board and papers taught. Nothing is lost from the work already done if the student keeps her notes. Waiting until February is the expensive choice, because the IA deadlines are already on you.

faqs.question: Is IB Gram affiliated with my child's school or with the IB?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is an independent tutoring platform, not affiliated with any school, any coaching institute or any examination board, and the schools named on this page are mentioned only as local context for how the Mumbai calendar works. Tutors are matched to the board and syllabus your child is actually studying, whether that is the Diploma Programme, MYP, or IGCSE through Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. We also do not guarantee grades, and no honest tutor or institute will claim to. What we take responsibility for is the match, the verification and replacing a tutor who is not working.

faqs.question: When is a coaching class alone enough, so we do not need a tutor at all?
faqs.answer: A class alone is enough when the student is steady, independent and lives near the batch. If your son is holding his subjects comfortably, submits IA drafts on his own before the school deadline, revises without being chased and walks ten minutes to a class he likes, a tutor adds cost rather than marks. The same is true for an IGCSE student doing fine who mainly needs volume of past papers before the May series. We would rather say that on the first call than sell you six hours a week you do not need.

A counsellor calls within a working day, separates the content gap from the coursework gap, and sends two or three tutor profiles with the board and papers each has taught. You run a first session at home or online, then tell us whether to keep the tutor, swap them, or narrow the brief.

sections.heading: What IB Gram in Mumbai does when your enquiry arrives
paragraphs: IB Gram in Mumbai is a matching platform, not a coaching centre and not a school. There is no building you visit, no batch your child joins and no syllabus of our own. What we hold is a roster of IB and IGCSE tutors across the city, a record of what each one has actually taught, and a process for putting the right one in front of the right student. The teaching itself is the tutor's work, and the learning is your child's. The match, the verification and the replacement are ours. Those three are the only things we will claim, and they are the only three you should hold us to.

An enquiry reaches us as a form, a call or a message on a phone. The useful version of it contains six things: the board, the year group, the subjects, the level, your locality and the two or three slots you can realistically keep every week for a term. With those six, a shortlist takes a day or two. Without them we come back and ask, which is why the first conversation with us is mostly questions rather than a pitch. A request that reads "IGCSE Maths help for my son in Khar West, Year 10, Extended tier, Tuesday and Friday after 6.30pm" is a request we can act on by the next evening. A request that reads "need a good tutor urgently" takes three days longer, because we still have to find out all six things before we can filter anybody. Most families arrive here after typing IB tutors near me Mumbai into a phone at ten at night, and that search tells Google a rough location while telling us nothing we can actually filter a roster on.
From the moment those six facts exist, the sequence is fixed and it does not change for anybody. We run it the same way for a PYP parent in Cuffe Parade and for a DP2 parent in Kandivali East:

Nothing in that sequence is clever. It is an ordinary filter applied in the right order. Board experience comes first, because a tutor who has taught CBSE Physics ably for a decade is not automatically ready for Diploma Programme Physics Higher Level, where the paper 2 data-analysis questions and the ten-hour Internal Assessment are a different job. Travel time comes second, because a tutor who needs ninety minutes each way will start cancelling around week six, whatever they promised in week one. The paid trial session comes last, because a parent's judgement after watching one session in their own house is better evidence than any profile we could write.

sections.heading: Which programmes and boards do we cover across Mumbai?
paragraphs: We cover the International Baccalaureate (IB) from the Primary Years Programme (PYP) through the Middle Years Programme (MYP) to the Diploma Programme (DP), plus the Cambridge International Education and Pearson Edexcel IGCSE pathways, Years 1 to 12. We do not run CBSE, ICSE or state-board tuition as a service line. Saying that plainly costs us enquiries every week and we still say it, because a tutor stretched across four boards is good at none of them. Covering all IB and IGCSE subjects means a tutor in Mumbai for each one, screened separately, rather than one generalist offered for everything.

In the PYP years the work is rarely remedial. A PYP parent in Worli or Santacruz West usually wants a tutor who can keep English and Maths fluency moving while the school runs transdisciplinary units, and who can read a report written in PYP language and translate it into what to practise on a Saturday morning. In the MYP the shape changes: four assessment criteria per subject, each marked out of eight, a Personal Project in MYP 5, and the on-screen eAssessments that some Mumbai schools enter students for. Most MYP requests that reach us are really about criterion C and criterion D, where students who can do the Maths still lose marks because they will not communicate their reasoning or reflect on it.

The DP is where the pressure concentrates. Six subjects, three at Higher Level (HL) and three at Standard Level (SL), plus the Core: Theory of Knowledge (TOK), the Extended Essay (EE) and Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS). Each subject carries its own Internal Assessment (IA), graded against published criteria by the school and moderated outside it. Grades run 1 to 7 per subject, 42 from six subjects and up to 3 bonus points from TOK and the EE. A DP1 student who misreads how much the IA is worth in November has a harder DP2 than one who started the data collection in the monsoon term.

On the IGCSE side the first real decision is tiering. Cambridge Maths and the sciences split into Core and Extended, Edexcel into Foundation and Higher, and that choice caps the grade before a single paper is sat. Grades arrive as 9 to 1 or A* to G depending on the series and the school's entry. Exams run in the May and June series and again in October and November, which matters for a Year 11 student in Mumbai who needs one subject re-sat without losing the whole year. What we will not do is tell your school which tier to enter your child for. We will give you the evidence to have that conversation with the school yourself.

sections.heading: Subject by subject: what a tutor has to prove before we list them
paragraphs: Subject choice across both boards is where most families actually need help, and it is the part no generalist tutor can do. A DP student picking between Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches and Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation, at HL or SL, is choosing a different exam, a different toolkit and a different set of university doors. The same student choosing between Physics HL and Chemistry HL is choosing which Internal Assessment they will be writing in DP2 and how many hours it will eat. We ask a tutor to explain those trade-offs in a screening call before we list them, and if they cannot, they stay off the roster for that subject whatever their degree says.

The internal assessments are the clearest test of whether a tutor knows the syllabus or only the subject. DP Physics and Chemistry carry a single scientific investigation with published criteria covering research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation, and the commonest failure we see is a beautiful experiment with no justified uncertainty treatment. DP Economics carries a portfolio of three commentaries, each on a different unit and each tied to a news article published within a set window, which means a student who leaves them all to February has lost the choice of article. DP English Language and Literature carries an Individual Oral built on a global issue and two extracts, one literary and one non-literary. Business Management carries a research project; Visual Arts carries a comparative study and an exhibition; History carries an HL essay as well as the internal investigation.

At IGCSE the equivalent detail is in the papers. Cambridge Maths Extended candidates sit papers that carry structured multi-mark questions where method marks are available and routinely thrown away by students who show nothing. Cambridge and Edexcel sciences differ in how practical skills are examined, so an IGCSE Physics tutor who has only ever prepared Edexcel candidates will misjudge an alternative-to-practical paper. English First Language is assessed on directed writing and reading response rather than on literary knowledge, and a student who reads widely can still score poorly for ignoring the question's register and audience.

Two things we will not do, and both are asked of us often. We will not have a tutor write, draft or heavily edit an Internal Assessment, an Extended Essay or a coursework piece, because that is academic misconduct and it is your child who is reported for it, not us. And we will not promise a tutor for every subject in every locality on demand. There are subjects, Visual Arts, Music, Film, Psychology at HL, where we may need a week, or where the honest answer is online rather than a home tutor who is physically nearby. We will look for a home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai schools actually offer, and we will tell you when the search for a particular one is going to take longer than two days.

sections.heading: Where in Mumbai we can place a home tutor, and where it gets hard
paragraphs: IB Gram in Mumbai matches across all six zones of the metropolitan region, and the honest version of that sentence includes the places where it is difficult. In South Mumbai we place home tutors in Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Fort, Walkeshwar, Babulnath, Tardeo, Peddar Road and Worli. Distances here are short and the clock still beats you: a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba covers about eight kilometres and can lose forty minutes to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals at 7pm. So we match within the island rather than bringing somebody down from the suburbs, using the Western Line between Churchgate, Grant Road and Mumbai Central, the Harbour Line at CSMT and Dockyard, Metro Line 3 from Cuffe Parade towards BKC, and the Coastal Road.

The Western Suburbs are our largest catchment: Bandra, Khar, Santacruz, Juhu, Andheri, Goregaon, Malad, Kandivali, Borivali and Dahisar. The zone runs north to south along the Western Express Highway, Link Road and the Western Line, with Metro Line 1 crossing from Versova through Andheri to Ghatkopar and Metro Lines 2A and 7 running Dahisar to Gundavali. Matching along the line works; matching across it does not. Khar to Santacruz is a twelve-minute hop. Malad to Kandivali is fine. Bandra to Andheri is quick at 3pm and painful at 6pm, and anything that needs the Bandra-Worli Sea Link twice a week in peak traffic is a slot that will quietly collapse. In the Central Suburbs we cover Powai, Chandivali, Kurla, Ghatkopar and Mulund. Powai is the awkward one: physically central, no station of its own, so tutors arrive by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar via JVLR, and the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road carries the cross-town traffic.

The Eastern Suburbs run from Chembur and Govandi up through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund, on the Central and Harbour lines, the Eastern Express Highway and the Monorail between Chembur and Wadala. The Eastern Freeway makes South Mumbai genuinely reachable from Chembur and Wadala, faster than the map suggests, which is why a few of our South Mumbai placements are actually tutors who live east. Navi Mumbai is planned in nodes, Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel, each a short drive from the next on Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, with the Harbour Line, the Trans-Harbour Line and Navi Mumbai Metro Line 1 from Belapur to Pendhar. The Atal Setu has changed the Mumbai, Maharashtra commute map, but we still match node to node: pulling a tutor across the creek for a 7pm weekday lesson rarely holds for a full term, whatever anybody promises in June.

Thane spreads west to east from the station across Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Ghodbunder Road towards Kasarvadavali, and Ghodbunder sets the schedule for everything. A tutor living near Thane station reaches Kasarvadavali in twenty minutes off-peak and close to an hour in the evening, so Thane tutors cover Thane and a Mulund tutor crosses over only when the subject is scarce. Here is the limit stated plainly: if you are in an outer pocket and need a rare HL subject at 6pm on a weekday, we may not have a home tutor who can hold that slot for a term. We will tell you that in the first conversation and offer online or a weekend slot instead, rather than send somebody who will cancel in August.

sections.heading: How the Mumbai school calendar decides what a tutor can fix
paragraphs: Mumbai international schools run a June to April year, and that calendar decides what a tutor can realistically change and when. June and July are the cheapest months to start and the hardest to persuade a parent to start in, because nothing has gone wrong yet. August and September are when MYP criteria marks and IGCSE class tests begin to land. October brings mocks in many schools. November and December take DP1 students into their first formal examinations and DP2 students into Extended Essay and Internal Assessment deadlines stacked against each other. January and February are the hard months: DP2 mocks, predicted grades being finalised, IA final submissions, and the TOK essay going to the school. March and April are the May session papers for DP and the IGCSE series. A family who calls in late January is asking a tutor to compress eight months of work into six weeks, and the honest answer is that revision technique and paper strategy can still move marks, while a two-year content gap cannot be closed in that window.

Families who come to us attend schools across the whole region and each one sets its own internal rhythm. Dhirubhai Ambani International School and Ascend International School in BKC, the American School of Bombay, Ecole Mondiale World School, Jamnabai Narsee International School and Utpal Shanghvi Global School in Juhu, Oberoi International School on JVLR in Goregaon East, Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, Bombay International School at Babulnath, Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo, Activity High School on Peddar Road, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, JBCN International School at Parel, Borivali, Oshiwara and Chembur, NES International School in Mulund West, Thakur International School in Kandivali East, Singapore International School in Dahisar East, Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul, Navi Mumbai. Knowing a school's internal deadline pattern is useful context for planning sessions, and that is the entire extent of the relationship.

IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page, nor with the International Baccalaureate Organisation, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. We have no arrangement with any school, we receive nothing from any school, and no tutor on our roster speaks for a school. If a profile ever implies otherwise, that is an error and we want to hear about it.

This boundary has practical consequences worth knowing before you enquire. We cannot get a subject change approved, move an internal deadline, influence a predicted grade, obtain a copy of your child's internal mark scheme, or attend a parent-teacher meeting on your behalf. What a tutor can do is prepare you for those conversations: a written note on where the marks are being lost, which criterion or paper section it maps to, and what has been practised since. Parents who walk into a January meeting with that note have a different conversation from parents who walk in with a worry.

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid: which should you ask for?
paragraphs: Ask for home tuition first. For almost every family who contacts IB Gram in Mumbai, an IB home tutor in Mumbai who sits at the dining table beats the same person on a screen, because the tutor sees the notebook, catches the wrong method as it is being written, and cannot be ignored while a second browser tab is open. A home tutor also sees the working conditions: the study corner next to the television, the younger sibling's practice hour, the fact that Thursday is always a write-off. Those observations change the plan more often than any diagnostic test does.

IB home tuition in Mumbai has two real costs and we would rather you hear them from us. The first is the schedule. A home tutor has to get to you, so your 6pm slot in Lower Parel and their 8pm slot in Andheri West cannot both exist, and travel is priced into the rate whether or not anybody itemises it. The second is scarcity. Insisting on a home tutor narrows the roster to people who can reach your address repeatedly, and for a scarce HL subject in an outer node that can mean a shortlist of one, or none.

Online is not the consolation prize. An IB online tutor in Mumbai gives you the whole city's roster instead of one corridor's, no travel loss on either side, a recording to revisit and a shared document the student can reopen the night before the test. For a DP2 student working through past paper questions, screen-sharing a marked script is often clearer than two people leaning over one page. Online is weakest with younger students who need a physical presence to stay on task, with subjects that need the tutor to watch a hand write out a long derivation, and in buildings where the evening connection drops. If your child is in MYP 1 to MYP 3, we will push you towards home classes.

Hybrid is what most of our longer placements settle into after a month, and nobody asks for it on day one. One home session a week for the work that needs a person in the room: marking by hand, setting the week, going through a returned paper line by line. One online session for drill, doubt-clearing before a test, or the twenty-minute check the night before an IA deadline. It survives the Mumbai monsoon, it survives exam week when the student cannot afford the travel either, and it costs less in total travel than two home visits. All IB and IGCSE subjects run as home classes Mumbai wide by default, and we move the second weekly slot online when the calendar gets tight.
bullets: Home tuition first: the tutor sees the notebook, the method and the room
Travel is real and it is priced in, however the rate is presented
Online opens the whole city roster for scarce HL and SL subjects
Younger MYP students usually need a tutor physically in the room
Hybrid: one home session for marking, one online for drill and doubts

sections.heading: What we verify about a tutor, and what you should check yourself
paragraphs: Before a profile reaches you, IB Gram in Mumbai has checked four things and we will tell you exactly which four. One: identity, against a government photo identity document, with the name on it matching the name on the profile. Two: qualifications, against the actual degree or postgraduate certificate, not against a typed claim. Three: board teaching history, meaning which boards and which levels they have taught, for how long, and in what setting, with references we contact rather than collect. Four: subject-level competence, screened in a call by somebody who has taught that syllabus, including a short piece of student work for them to mark and justify. A tutor who marks that sample generously and cannot explain the criterion behind the mark does not get listed for that subject.

Here is what verification cannot do, which matters more than the list above. A document check tells you who somebody is, not whether they can teach your specific child. We have listed tutors with excellent credentials who were wrong for a particular student: too fast, too gentle, too committed to one method, or simply a personality mismatch with a fifteen-year-old. No amount of paperwork predicts that. It is the reason the first session is a paid trial you can walk away from, and the reason we replace without argument. We would rather hold a reputation for fast replacement than pretend our screening is better than it is. An IB private tutor Mumbai parents hire straight from a neighbour's recommendation has had none of these four checks run on them, which is usually fine and is occasionally not, and either way nobody is going to replace them for you in five days.

So check these things yourself, in the first two weeks, because you can and we cannot. Be at home for the first session, not in the next room with the door shut. Hold sessions in a common room rather than a bedroom, and keep the door open. Ask the tutor at the gate for the same photo identity they gave us, and look at it. After session two, ask for the plan in writing: what is weak, what order it will be fixed in, what you should expect to see by week four. Ask to see marked work, not a verbal report that everything is going well.

Two more things we do, which nobody asks about but which affect you. We log every placement, so when a tutor is replaced for the same reason by two different families, they stop being offered for that profile. And we do not pass your phone number around a group of tutors to see who bites. Your details go to the tutors on your shortlist and nowhere else, which is why you get three profiles and not thirty calls.
bullets: Identity against government photo ID, with the profile name matching exactly
Degrees seen as documents, references contacted rather than simply collected

sections.heading: One Mumbai family's enquiry, from first message to the fourth session
paragraphs: A parent in Chembur messages on a Sunday night. Her daughter is in DP1 at a school in Powai, taking Physics HL, Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches SL and Economics SL, and the first school report has come back with a comment about Physics that the family has read four times without understanding. The message we receive says: Physics tutor needed, DP1, urgently. That is not yet something we can act on, so Monday morning is questions. Which paper did the marks come off. Is the Internal Assessment topic chosen. Which days are already taken by school commitments. Chembur or somewhere else for the sessions. By Monday afternoon we know it is really two problems: paper 2 structured questions, and a student who has not started thinking about the ten-hour investigation that will be due in DP2.

Monday evening we filter. Board experience first, so only tutors with Diploma Programme Physics HL experience, not school Physics in general. Then geography: tutors who can reach Chembur on a weekday evening, which in practice means people living in the Eastern Suburbs along the Central and Harbour lines, or in the Central Suburbs reachable by the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road, rather than anybody west of the Western Express Highway. Then the slots: Tuesday and Saturday. Three profiles go out on Tuesday morning with qualifications, boards taught, and an honest travel note on each. The parent picks the second one, a tutor in Vikhroli, partly because the travel note said thirty minutes rather than an optimistic fifteen.

The first session is the following Saturday morning, at home, paid, ninety minutes. It is not teaching. The tutor works through the returned paper 2 with the student and writes down what he finds: she can do the physics and loses marks on command terms, writing an explanation where the question said calculate and vice versa, and she does not state assumptions in the two-mark openers. He also asks her what she might investigate for the IA, gets a shrug, and writes that down too. By Saturday afternoon the parent has a short written plan: four weeks on command terms and paper technique, IA topic narrowed to three options by week three, no new content until the technique is fixed.

Sessions two, three and four are Tuesday evenings and Saturday mornings, and this is where the honest part sits. By session four the tutor can show the parent which of the paper 2 question types are now being answered in the right form and which are not, with the marked scripts to prove it, and the IA has become a single testable question about the damping of an oscillating system. What has not happened by session four is a change in her school grade, because her next assessment is three weeks away. That is the correct state of affairs at four sessions, and any platform telling you otherwise is selling you something. What we did was the match, the verification and the written plan. What we did not do is the physics, and we did not promise the 7.
bullets: Sunday enquiry, Monday questions, Tuesday shortlist, Saturday first session at home
